capabilities: Anchor comment threads to selected text passages and image embeds
Reply, edit, resolve, delete and search comments in a side panel
Store threads and anchors in sidecar JSON files without modifying notes
Request AI replies from Ollama, Gemini or Claude with a send preview
extras: Alpha (0.3.1), desktop only, no mobile support; flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Extensive disclosures on network use and CLI isolation; further compatibility details live in docs/compatibility.md. README describes the project as written by AI coding agents (OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code) with Gitar and SonarQube review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach threaded, resolvable comments to passages or images without editing the note's own content.

relations.evidence: Mention @Local, @Gemini or @Claude in a comment, or press Ask AI.
the Gemini and Claude assistants start the gemini and claude command-line tools you installed
